sentences.zh: 紀元曆

translations.literal: Jiyuan Calendar
translations.idiomatic: The Jiyuan Calendar

sentences.zh: 步交會

translations.literal: Step convergence
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Lunar Nodes and Conjunctions

sentences.zh: 交終分：一十九萬八千三百七十七、秒八百八十。

translations.literal: Convergence termination parts: 198,377, seconds 880.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination parts: 198,377; seconds 880.

sentences.zh: 交終日：二十七、餘一千五百四十七、秒八百八十。

translations.literal: Convergence termination day: 27 days, remainder 1,547, seconds 880.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination period: 27 days, remainder 1,547 parts, seconds 880.

sentences.zh: 交中日：一十三、餘四千四百一十八、秒五千四百四十。

translations.literal: Convergence middle day: 13 days, remainder 4,418, seconds 5,440.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence middle period: 13 days, remainder 4,418 parts, seconds 5,440.

sentences.zh: 朔差日：二、餘二千三百二十、秒九千一百二十。

translations.literal: New-moon difference day: 2 days, remainder 2,320, seconds 9,120.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon difference: 2 days, remainder 2,320 parts, seconds 9,120.

sentences.zh: 望策：一十四、餘五千五百七十九。

translations.literal: Full-moon stride: 14 days, remainder 5,579.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon stride: 14 days, remainder 5,579 parts.

sentences.zh: 已上秒母一萬。

translations.literal: Above, the seconds mother is 10,000.
translations.idiomatic: For the above constants, the seconds denominator is 10,000.

sentences.zh: 交率：三百二十四。

translations.literal: Convergence ratio: 324.
translations.idiomatic: The convergence ratio is 324.

sentences.zh: 交數：四千一百二十七。

translations.literal: Convergence number: 4,127.
translations.idiomatic: The convergence number is 4,127.

sentences.zh: 交終度：三百六十三、約分七十九、秒四十四。

translations.literal: Convergence termination degrees: 363 degrees, 79 approximate parts, 44 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence termination arc: 363°79′44″ (approximate parts).

sentences.zh: 交中度：一百八十一、約分八十九、秒七十二。

translations.literal: Convergence middle degrees: 181 degrees, 89 approximate parts, 72 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence middle arc: 181°89′72″ (approximate parts).

sentences.zh: 交象度：九十、約分九十四、秒八十六。

translations.literal: Convergence image degrees: 90 degrees, 94 approximate parts, 86 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convergence image arc: 90°94′86″ (approximate parts).

sentences.zh: 半交象度：四十五、約分四十七、秒四十三。

translations.literal: Half convergence image degrees: 45 degrees, 47 approximate parts, 43 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Half convergence image arc: 45°47′43″ (approximate parts).

sentences.zh: 日食陽曆限：三千四百，定法三百四十。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse yang-calendar limit: 3,400; fixed divisor 340.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse yang-calendar limit: 3,400; fixing divisor 340.

sentences.zh: 陰曆限：四千三百，定法四百三十。

translations.literal: Yin-calendar limit: 4,300; fixed divisor 430.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse yin-calendar limit: 4,300; fixing divisor 430.

sentences.zh: 月食限：六千八百，定法四百四十。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse limit: 6,800; fixed divisor 440.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse limit: 6,800; fixing divisor 440.

sentences.zh: 已上分秒母各同一百。

translations.literal: Above, the parts-and-seconds mothers are each 100.
translations.idiomatic: For the limits above, the parts-and-seconds denominators are each 100.

sentences.zh: 推天正十一月經朔加時入交：置天正十一月經朔加時積分，以交終分及秒去之，不盡，滿日法為日，不滿為餘秒，即天正十一月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour entry into convergence: set the civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour accumulated parts; remove by the convergence termination parts and seconds; what does not exhaust, when it fills the day divisor becomes days, what does not fill is remainder-seconds — that is the civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eleventh civil month's mean new-moon hour of entry into convergence: set the accumulated parts for that syzygy's hour, cast out full convergence termination parts and seconds, convert the remainder through the day divisor into days and remainder-seconds, and obtain the general convergence day and remainder-seconds for the eleventh month's mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及望入交：置天正十一月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒，求次朔，以朔差加之；

translations.literal: To find the next new moon and full moon entry into convergence: set the civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds; to find the next new moon, add the new-moon difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the next new and full moon entry into convergence: set the eleventh-month mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds; for the next new moon, add the new-moon difference;

sentences.zh: 求望，以望策加之：滿交終日及餘秒去之，即各得次朔及望加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: to find the full moon, add the full-moon stride: when full, remove the convergence termination day and remainder-seconds — each yields the next new moon and full moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: for the full moon add the full-moon stride; cast out full convergence termination days and remainder-seconds to obtain each next new or full moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 若以經朔、望小餘減之，各得朔、望夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If one subtracts the mean new- or full-moon minor remainder, each yields the new or full moon midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtracting each mean syzygy's minor remainder yields the midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds for that new or full moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望夜半入交：因經朔、望夜半入交泛日及餘秒，視定朔、望日辰有進退者，亦進退交日，否則因經為定，各得所求。

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon midnight entry into convergence: from the mean new- or full-moon midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds, if the fixed new- or full-moon day-period has advance or retreat, advance or retreat the convergence day likewise; otherwise follow the mean as fixed — each yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy midnight convergence entry: start from mean midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds; if the fixed syzygy's day-period advances or retreats, adjust the convergence day likewise, otherwise take the mean value as fixed.

sentences.zh: 求次定朔夜半入交：各因定朔夜半入交泛日及餘秒，大月加二日，小月加一日，餘皆加五千七百四十二、秒九千一百二十，即次朔夜半入交；

translations.literal: To find the next fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence: from each fixed new-moon midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds, in a long month add two days, in a short month one day; to the remainder always add 5,742 seconds 9,120 — that is the next new moon's midnight convergence entry;
translations.idiomatic: For the next fixed new-moon midnight entry: from each fixed new-moon midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds, add two days in a long month and one in a short month, and always add 5,742 seconds 9,120 to the remainder for the next new moon's midnight entry;

sentences.zh: 若求次日，累加一日：滿交終日及餘秒皆去之，即每日夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: to seek the next day, accumulate one day: when full remove the convergence termination day and remainder-seconds — that is each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: to advance day by day, add one day cumulatively, cast out full convergence termination days and remainder-seconds, and obtain each midnight general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時入交：置經朔、望加時入交泛日及餘秒，以入氣、入轉朏朒定數朏減朒加之，即得定朔、望加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence: set the mean new- and full-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds; with the entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, tiao subtract and chuo add — that is the fixed new- and full-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy hour-of-addition convergence entry: set mean syzygy hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds, apply entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers (tiao subtract, chuo add), and obtain fixed syzygy hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時月行入交積度：置定朔、望加時入交泛日及餘秒，以日法通日，內餘，進一位，如五千四百五十三而一為度，不滿，退除為分，即定朔、望加時月行入交積度及分。

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry-into-convergence accumulated degrees: set the fixed new- or full-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds; communicate the day by the day divisor and include the remainder, advance one place, take 5,453 as one degree, what does not fill reduce to parts — that is the fixed new- or full-moon hour moon's entry-into-convergence accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy hour moon convergence accumulated degrees: convert the general convergence day through the day divisor with the remainder, shift one place, divide by 5,453 for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts, and obtain the hour moon's convergence accumulated degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 每日夜半，准此求之。

translations.literal: Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For each midnight, follow this procedure.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時月行入交定積度：置定朔、望加時月行入交積度及分，以定朔、望加時入轉遲疾度遲減疾加之，滿與不足，進退交終度及分。

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour moon's fixed entry-into-convergence accumulated degrees: set the fixed syzygy hour moon entry-into-convergence accumulated degrees and parts; with the fixed syzygy hour entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree, slow subtract and fast add; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the convergence termination degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy hour moon fixed convergence accumulated degrees: set hour convergence accumulated degrees and parts, apply hour entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree (slow subtract, fast add), and advance or retreat convergence termination degrees and parts as needed.

sentences.zh: 即定朔、望加時月行入交定積度及分。

translations.literal: That is the fixed new- or full-moon hour moon's fixed entry-into-convergence accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: That yields the fixed syzygy hour moon's fixed convergence accumulated degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 每日夜半，准此求之。

translations.literal: Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For each midnight, follow this procedure.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時月行入陰陽曆積度：置定朔、望加時月行入交定積度及分，如在交中度及分已下為入陽曆積度；

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour moon's entry into yang/yin calendar accumulated degrees: set the fixed syzygy hour moon fixed convergence accumulated degrees and parts; if at or below the convergence middle degrees and parts, it is yang-calendar accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy hour yang/yin calendar accumulated degrees: set fixed hour moon fixed convergence accumulated degrees and parts; at or below convergence middle counts as yang-calendar accumulated degrees;

sentences.zh: 已上者去之，餘為入陰曆積度。

translations.literal: if above, remove it; the remainder is yin-calendar accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract convergence middle; the remainder is yin-calendar accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 每日夜半，准此求之。

translations.literal: Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For each midnight, follow this procedure.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時月去黃道度：視月入陰陽曆積度及分，如交象已下為在少象；

translations.literal: To find fixed new- and full-moon hour moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees: inspect the moon's entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degrees and parts; at or below the convergence image is in the young image;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy hour lunar ecliptic latitude: inspect entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degrees and parts; at or below the convergence image counts as the young image;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減交中度，餘為入老象。

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract the convergence middle; the remainder is entry into the old image.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract convergence middle; the remainder is entry into the old image.

sentences.zh: 置所入老、少象度及分於上，列交象度於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，五百而一，所得，用減所入老、少象度及分，餘，列交中度於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，滿一千三百七十五而一，所得為度，不滿，退除為分，即為定朔、望加時月去黃道度及分。

translations.literal: Set the entered young or old image degrees and parts above and array the convergence image degrees below; subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per 500; use the result to subtract from the entered young or old image degrees and parts; array the convergence middle degrees below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per 1,375 for degrees, what does not fill reduce to parts — that is the fixed new- or full-moon hour moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set entered young or old image degrees above and convergence image degrees below, subtract and multiply (divide by 500), subtract from entered image degrees, then subtract and multiply against convergence middle (divide by 1,375), reduce to parts, and obtain fixed syzygy hour lunar ecliptic latitude in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 每日夜半，准此求之。

translations.literal: Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For each midnight, follow this procedure.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交常日：置其月經朔、望加時入交泛日及餘秒，以其月入氣朏朒定數朏減朒加之，滿與不足，進退其日，即得朔、望加時入交常日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find new- and full-moon hour general convergence day: set that month's mean new- or full-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds; with that month's entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number, tiao subtract and chuo add; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day — that is the new- or full-moon hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find syzygy hour general convergence day: set the month's mean syzygy hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds, apply entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number (tiao subtract, chuo add), adjust the day as needed, and obtain syzygy hour general convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 近交初為交初，在二十六日、二十七日為交初；

translations.literal: Near convergence beginning is convergence beginning; on the twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh day is convergence beginning;
translations.idiomatic: Near the start of convergence counts as convergence beginning; days twenty-six or twenty-seven are convergence beginning;

sentences.zh: 近交中為交中，在十三日、十四日為交中。

translations.literal: near convergence middle is convergence middle; on the thirteenth or fourteenth day is convergence middle.
translations.idiomatic: near convergence middle counts as convergence middle; days thirteen or fourteen are convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚定數：以其朔望入氣、入轉朏朒定數，同名相從，異名相消，副置之；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse greatest fixed number: with that new or full moon's entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, of the same name follow together, of different name cancel, and set aside as auxiliary;
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse greatest fixed number: combine that syzygy's entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers (same name together, different name cancel) and set aside as auxiliary;

sentences.zh: 以定朔、望加時入轉算外損益率乘之，如日法而一，其定朔、望如算外在四七日者，視其餘在初數已下，初率乘之，初數而一；

translations.literal: multiply by the fixed new- or full-moon hour entry-into-rotation count-outside damage-benefit rate, one per day divisor; if the fixed new or full moon is count-outside on the four-seven day, inspect whether the remainder is at or below the initial number — multiply by the initial rate, one per initial number;
translations.idiomatic: multiply auxiliary by fixed syzygy hour entry-into-rotation count-outside damage-benefit rate and divide by the day divisor; if fixed syzygy is count-outside on days four–seven and remainder is at or below the initial number, multiply by the initial rate and divide by the initial number;

sentences.zh: 初數已上，以末率乘之，末數而一。

translations.literal: if above the initial number, multiply by the final rate, one per final number.
translations.idiomatic: if above the initial number, multiply by the final rate and divide by the final number.

sentences.zh: 所得，視入轉，應朒者依其損益，應朏者益減損加其副；

translations.literal: With the result, inspect entry-into-rotation: if it responds to chuo, follow its damage-benefit; if it responds to tiao, benefit-subtract and damage-add to the auxiliary;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the result according to entry-into-rotation: for chuo follow damage-benefit; for tiao benefit-subtract and damage-add to the auxiliary;

sentences.zh: 以朏減朒加經朔望小餘，為泛餘。

translations.literal: tiao subtract and chuo add to the mean new- or full-moon minor remainder — that is the general remainder.
translations.idiomatic: apply tiao subtract and chuo add to the mean syzygy minor remainder to obtain the general remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿與不足，進退大餘。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, advance or retreat the major remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Advance or retreat the major remainder when the sum overflows or falls short.

sentences.zh: 日食者視泛餘，如半法已下，為中前；

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: inspect the general remainder; at or below the half method is before middle;
translations.idiomatic: For solar eclipse, if the general remainder is at or below the half method, it is before middle;

sentences.zh: 列半法於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，如一萬九百三十五而一，所得，為差；

translations.literal: array the half method below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per 10,935 — the result is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: array the half method below, subtract and multiply (divide by 10,935), and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 以減泛餘，為食甚定餘；

translations.literal: subtract the difference from the general remainder — that is the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the difference from the general remainder to obtain the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;

sentences.zh: 用減半法，為午前分。

translations.literal: subtracting the half method yields the before-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: subtracting the half method yields the before-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 如泛餘在半法已上，減去半法，為中後；

translations.literal: if the general remainder is at or above the half method, subtract the half method — that is after middle;
translations.idiomatic: if the general remainder is at or above the half method, subtract the half method for after middle;

sentences.zh: 列半法於下。

translations.literal: Array the half method below.
translations.idiomatic: Place the half method in the lower row of the array.

sentences.zh: 以上減下，餘以乘上，如日法而一，所得，為差；

translations.literal: subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per day divisor — the result is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: subtract below from above, multiply and divide by the day divisor, and obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 以加泛餘，為食甚定餘；

translations.literal: add the difference to the general remainder — that is the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;
translations.idiomatic: add the difference to the general remainder to obtain the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;

sentences.zh: 乃減去半法，為午後分。

translations.literal: then subtract the half method — that is the after-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: then subtract the half method to obtain the after-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 月食者視泛餘，如半法已上減去半法，餘在一千八百二十二半已下自相乘，已上者，覆減半法，餘亦自相乘，如三萬而一，所得，以減泛餘，為食甚定餘；

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: inspect the general remainder; if at or above the half method subtract the half method, and if the remainder is at or below 1,822 and a half, square it; if above, cover and subtract the half method and square the remainder likewise, one per 30,000 — use the result to subtract from the general remainder for the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipse, if general remainder is at or above half method subtract half method; square remainder if ≤1,822.5, otherwise cover-subtract half method and square, divide by 30,000, and subtract from general remainder for eclipse-greatest fixed remainder;

sentences.zh: 如泛餘不滿半法，在日出分三分之二已下，列於上位，已上者，用減日出分，餘倍之，亦列於上位，乃四因三約日出分，列之於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，如一萬五千而一，所得，以加泛餘，為食甚定餘。

translations.literal: if the general remainder does not fill the half method and is at or below two-thirds of the sunrise part, array it above; if above, subtract the sunrise part and double the remainder and also array above; then quadruple and three-reduce the sunrise part and array below; subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, one per 15,000 — add the result to the general remainder for the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If general remainder is below half method and within two-thirds of sunrise part, array above; if above, adjust against sunrise part, double, array, reduce sunrise part by 4/3, subtract and multiply (divide by 15,000), and add to general remainder for eclipse-greatest fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚辰刻：倍食甚定餘，以辰法除之為辰數，不盡，五因之，滿刻法除之為刻，不滿為分。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest watch and quarter: double the eclipse-greatest fixed remainder; divide by the watch divisor for watch count, what does not exhaust multiply by five, when it fills the quarter divisor divide for quarters, what does not fill is parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse-greatest watch and quarter: double the fixed remainder, divide by watch divisor for watches, convert remainder to quarters (multiply by five, divide by quarter divisor), and obtain parts.

sentences.zh: 命辰數起子正，算外，即食甚辰刻及分。

translations.literal: Count watches from zi-zheng outside the count — that is the eclipse-greatest watch, quarter, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count watches from zi-zheng, outside the count, to obtain eclipse-greatest watch, quarter, and parts.

sentences.zh: 若加半辰，命起子初。

translations.literal: If one adds half a watch, count from zi-initial.
translations.idiomatic: If adding half a watch, count from zi-initial.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚入氣：食甚大、小餘及食定小餘，並定朔、望大餘，以此與經朔望大、小餘相減。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest entry into qi: eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders together with eclipse-fixed minor remainder and fixed new- or full-moon major remainder — compare these with the mean new- or full-moon major and minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse-greatest entry into qi: combine eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders with eclipse-fixed minor remainder and fixed syzygy major remainder, and compare with mean syzygy major and minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 置其朔望食甚大、小餘，與經朔望大、小餘相減之，餘以加減經朔望入氣日餘，經朔望少即加之，多即減之。

translations.literal: Set the new- or full-moon eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders and subtract the mean new- or full-moon major and minor remainders; to the remainder add or subtract the mean new- or full-moon entry-into-qi day remainder — if the mean new or full moon is less, add; if more, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set syzygy eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders, subtract mean syzygy remainders, and add or subtract mean syzygy entry-into-qi day remainder according to whether mean syzygy is less or more.

sentences.zh: 為日、月食甚入氣日及餘秒。

translations.literal: That is the solar or lunar eclipse-greatest entry-into-qi day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: That yields solar or lunar eclipse-greatest entry-into-qi day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 各置食甚入氣及餘秒，加其氣中積，其餘，以日法退除為分，即為日、月食甚中積及分。

translations.literal: Set each eclipse-greatest entry into qi and remainder-seconds, add its qi middle accumulation; to the remainder, retreat-divide by the day divisor for parts — that is the solar or lunar eclipse-greatest middle accumulation and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For each eclipse-greatest entry into qi and remainder-seconds, add qi middle accumulation, convert remainder through day divisor into parts, and obtain eclipse-greatest middle accumulation and parts.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚日行積度：置食甚入氣餘，以所入氣日盈縮分乘之，日法而一，加減其日先後數，至後加，分後減。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest daily motion accumulated degrees: set the eclipse-greatest entry-into-qi remainder, multiply by that qi day's excess-deficit parts, one per day divisor, add or subtract its day's before-after number — after the day add, after the parts subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse-greatest daily motion accumulated degrees: multiply eclipse-greatest entry-into-qi remainder by that qi day's excess-deficit parts (divide by day divisor), add or subtract day's before-after number (add after day, subtract after parts).

sentences.zh: 先加後減日、月食甚中積，即為日、月食甚日行積度及分。

translations.literal: First add then subtract to the solar or lunar eclipse-greatest middle accumulation — that is the solar or lunar eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply add-then-subtract to eclipse-greatest middle accumulation to obtain eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求氣差：置日食甚日行積度及分，滿二至限去之，餘在象限已下為在初；

translations.literal: To find qi difference: set the solar eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts; remove what fills the two solstice limit; if the remainder is at or below the image limit it is in the initial;
translations.idiomatic: To find qi difference: set solar eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts, cast out two solstice limit, and if remainder is at or below image limit it is initial;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減二至限，餘為在末。

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract the two solstice limit; the remainder is in the final.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract two solstice limit; the remainder is final.

sentences.zh: 皆自相乘，進二位，滿三百四十三而一，所得，用減二千四百三十，餘為氣差；

translations.literal: In each case square itself, advance two places, one per 343 — use the result to subtract from 2,430; the remainder is qi difference;
translations.idiomatic: Square each case, shift two places, divide by 343, subtract from 2,430, and obtain qi difference;

sentences.zh: 以午前、後分乘之。

translations.literal: multiply by the before- or after-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: multiply qi difference by the before- or after-noon part.

sentences.zh: 如半晝分而一，以減氣差，為氣差定數。

translations.literal: One per half day-part — subtract from qi difference; that is the qi-difference fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by half day-part, subtract from qi difference, and obtain qi-difference fixed number.

sentences.zh: 在冬至後末限、夏至後初限，交初以減，交中以加。

translations.literal: In the final limit after winter solstice and the initial limit after summer solstice, at convergence beginning subtract, at convergence middle add.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice in final limit and after summer solstice in initial limit: subtract at convergence beginning, add at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 夏至後末限、冬至後初限，交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: In the final limit after summer solstice and the initial limit after winter solstice, at convergence beginning add, at convergence middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice in final limit and after winter solstice in initial limit: add at convergence beginning, subtract at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 如半晝分而一，所得，在氣差已上者，即以氣差覆減之，余應加者為減，減者為加。

translations.literal: One per half day-part — if the result is at or above qi difference, cover and subtract qi difference from it; the remainder that should add becomes subtract, and subtract becomes add.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by half day-part; if result meets or exceeds qi difference, cover-subtract qi difference and invert add/subtract as required.

sentences.zh: 求刻差：置日食甚日行積度及分，滿二至限去之，餘列二至限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，滿三百四十三而一，所得為刻差。

translations.literal: To find quarter difference: set the solar eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts; remove what fills the two solstice limit; array the two solstice limit below, subtract below from above, multiply the remainder by above, advance two places, one per 343 — the result is quarter difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find quarter difference: set solar eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees and parts, cast out two solstice limit, subtract and multiply against limit (divide by 343), and obtain quarter difference.

sentences.zh: 以午前、後分乘而倍之，如半法而一，為刻差定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the before- or after-noon part and double; one per half method — that is the quarter-difference fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply quarter difference by before- or after-noon part, double, divide by half method, and obtain quarter-difference fixed number.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午前，夏至後食甚在午後，交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: After winter solstice, if eclipse-greatest is before noon; after summer solstice, if eclipse-greatest is after noon — at convergence beginning add, at convergence middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice with eclipse-greatest before noon, or after summer solstice after noon: add at convergence beginning, subtract at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午後，夏至後食甚在午前，交初以減，交中以加。

translations.literal: After winter solstice, if eclipse-greatest is after noon; after summer solstice, if eclipse-greatest is before noon — at convergence beginning subtract, at convergence middle add.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice with eclipse-greatest after noon, or after summer solstice before noon: subtract at convergence beginning, add at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 如半法而一，所得在刻差已上者，即倍刻差，以所得之數減之，餘為刻差定數，依其加減。

translations.literal: One per half method — if the result is at or above quarter difference, double the quarter difference and subtract by the number obtained; the remainder is the quarter-difference fixed number, following its add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by half method; if result meets or exceeds quarter difference, double quarter difference and subtract accordingly; apply add/subtract to obtain quarter-difference fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求朔入交定日：置朔入交常日及餘秒，以氣、刻差定數各加減之，交初加三千一百，交中減三千，為朔入交定日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find fixed new-moon entry-into-convergence fixed day: set the new-moon general convergence day and remainder-seconds; with qi- and quarter-difference fixed numbers each add or subtract; at convergence beginning add 3,100, at convergence middle subtract 3,000 — that is the new-moon fixed entry-into-convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed new-moon convergence fixed day: set new-moon general convergence day and remainder-seconds, apply qi- and quarter-difference fixed numbers, add 3,100 at convergence beginning and subtract 3,000 at convergence middle, and obtain new-moon fixed convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求望入交定日：置望入轉朏朒定數，以交率乘之，如交數而一，所得，以朏減朒加入交常日之余，滿與不足，進退其日，即望入交定日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find fixed full-moon entry-into-convergence fixed day: set the full-moon entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number; multiply by the convergence ratio, one per convergence number; with the result tiao subtract and chuo add to the general convergence day remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day — that is the full-moon fixed entry-into-convergence day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed full-moon convergence fixed day: set full-moon entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number, multiply by convergence ratio (divide by convergence number), apply tiao subtract and chuo add to general convergence remainder, adjust day as needed, and obtain full-moon fixed convergence day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求月行入陰陽曆：視其朔、望入交定日及餘秒，如在中日及餘秒已下為月在陽曆；

translations.literal: To find the moon's entry into yang/yin calendar: inspect the fixed new- or full-moon entry-into-convergence fixed day and remainder-seconds; if at or below the middle day and remainder-seconds, the moon is in the yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: To find moon yang/yin calendar entry: if fixed syzygy convergence fixed day and remainder-seconds are at or below middle day and remainder-seconds, the moon is in the yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 如中日及餘秒已上，減去中日，為月在陰曆。

translations.literal: if at or above the middle day and remainder-seconds, subtract the middle day — the moon is in the yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: if at or above middle day and remainder-seconds, subtract middle day; the moon is in the yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 求入食限交前後分：視其朔、望月行入陰陽曆，不滿日者為交後分；

translations.literal: To find before- and after-convergence parts for entry into the eclipse limit: inspect the fixed new- or full-moon moon's entry into yang/yin calendar; what does not fill a day is the after-convergence part;
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse-limit before- and after-convergence parts: inspect fixed syzygy moon yang/yin calendar entry; remainder below one day is after-convergence part;

sentences.zh: 在十三日上下者覆減交中日，為交前分；

translations.literal: if about the thirteenth day above or below, cover and subtract the convergence middle day — that is the before-convergence part;
translations.idiomatic: if within about thirteen days, cover and subtract convergence middle day for before-convergence part;

sentences.zh: 視交前、後分各在食限已下者為入食限。

translations.literal: inspect each before- and after-convergence part; if each is at or below the eclipse limit, it has entered the eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: if each before- and after-convergence part is at or below the eclipse limit, the syzygy has entered the eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 求日食分：以交前、後分各減陰陽曆食限，餘如定法而一，為日食之大分；

translations.literal: To find solar eclipse parts: from each before- and after-convergence part subtract the yin/yang calendar eclipse limit; the remainder, one per fixed divisor, is the solar eclipse major part;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse magnitude: subtract yin/yang calendar eclipse limit from each before- and after-convergence part, divide remainder by fixed divisor, and obtain solar eclipse major part;

sentences.zh: 不盡，退除為小分。

translations.literal: what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: reduce any remainder to minor parts.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，即得日食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major part with ten as limit — that is the solar eclipse part.
translations.idiomatic: Take the major part on a scale of ten to obtain solar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 其食不及大分者，行勢稍近交道，光氣微有映蔽，其日或食或不食。

translations.literal: If the eclipse does not reach a major part, the motion is slightly near the crossing path and light is faintly obscured; that day it may eclipse or may not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If magnitude falls short of a major part, the path is near the node and light is only faintly dimmed; an eclipse may or may not occur that day.

sentences.zh: 求月食分：視其望交前、後分，如二千四百已下者，食既；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse parts: inspect the full moon's before- and after-convergence parts; if at or below 2,400, the eclipse is total;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse magnitude: if full-moon before- and after-convergence parts are at or below 2,400, the eclipse is total;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減食限，餘如定法而一，為月食之大分；

translations.literal: if above, subtract from the eclipse limit; the remainder, one per fixed divisor, is the lunar eclipse major part;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from eclipse limit, divide remainder by fixed divisor, and obtain lunar eclipse major part;

sentences.zh: 不盡，退除為小分。

translations.literal: what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: reduce any remainder to minor parts.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，得月食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major part with ten as limit — obtain the lunar eclipse part.
translations.idiomatic: Take the major part on a scale of ten to obtain lunar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求日食泛用分：置交前、後分，自相乘，退二位，陽曆一百九十八而一，陰曆三百一十七而一，所得，用減五百八十三，餘為日食泛用分。

translations.literal: To find solar eclipse general use-parts: set the before- and after-convergence parts, square each, retreat two places; yang calendar one per 198, yin calendar one per 317; use the result to subtract from 583 — the remainder is the solar eclipse general use-part.
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse general use-parts: square before- and after-convergence parts (shift two places), divide by 198 (yang) or 317 (yin), subtract from 583, and obtain solar eclipse general use-part.

sentences.zh: 求月食泛用分：置交前、後分，自相乘，退二位，如七百四而一，所得，用減六百五十六，餘為月食泛用分。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse general use-parts: set the before- and after-convergence parts, square each, retreat two places, one per 704; use the result to subtract from 656 — the remainder is the lunar eclipse general use-part.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse general use-parts: square before- and after-convergence parts (shift two places), divide by 704, subtract from 656, and obtain lunar eclipse general use-part.

sentences.zh: 求日月食定用分：置日、月食泛用分，副之，以食甚加時入轉算外損益率乘之，如日法而一，如算外在四、七日者，依食定餘求之。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse fixed use-parts: set the solar or lunar eclipse general use-part and set aside as auxiliary; multiply by the eclipse-greatest hour entry-into-rotation count-outside damage-benefit rate, one per day divisor; if count-outside on days four or seven, seek by the eclipse-fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse fixed use-parts: set general use-part as auxiliary, multiply by eclipse-greatest hour entry-into-rotation count-outside damage-benefit rate (divide by day divisor), and on days four or seven apply eclipse-fixed remainder rule.

sentences.zh: 所得，應朒者依其損益，應朏者益減損加其副，即為日月食定用分。

translations.literal: With the result, if it responds to chuo follow its damage-benefit; if it responds to tiao, benefit-subtract and damage-add to the auxiliary — that is the solar and lunar eclipse fixed use-part.
translations.idiomatic: Apply result according to entry-into-rotation (chuo: follow damage-benefit; tiao: benefit-subtract, damage-add to auxiliary) to obtain solar and lunar eclipse fixed use-part.

sentences.zh: 求月食既內外分：置月食交前、後分，自相乘，退二位，如二百四十九而一，所得，用減二百三十一，餘以定用分乘之，如泛用分而一，為月食既內分；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse total inner and outer parts: set the lunar eclipse before- and after-convergence parts, square each, retreat two places, one per 249; use the result to subtract from 231; multiply the remainder by the fixed use-part, one per general use-part — that is the lunar eclipse total inner part;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse total inner and outer parts: square lunar eclipse before- and after-convergence parts (shift two places), divide by 249, subtract from 231, multiply remainder by fixed use-part (divide by general use-part), and obtain lunar eclipse total inner part;

sentences.zh: 用減定用分，餘為既外分。

translations.literal: Subtract these from the fixed use-part; the remainder is the total outer part.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the total inner part from the fixed use-part to obtain the total outer part.

sentences.zh: 求日月食虧初復滿小餘：置日、月食甚小餘，各以定用分減之，為虧初；

translations.literal: To find sun and moon eclipse first diminishment, restoration fullness, and minor remainders: set the sun and moon eclipse-greatest minor remainders; for each subtract the fixed use-part — that is first diminishment;
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse first diminishment, restoration fullness, and minor remainders: set sun and moon eclipse-greatest minor remainders, subtract the fixed use-part from each, and obtain first diminishment;

sentences.zh: 加之，為復滿；

translations.literal: Add it — that is restoration fullness;
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed use-part to obtain restoration fullness;

sentences.zh: 其月食既者，以既內分減之，為初既；

translations.literal: When the lunar eclipse is total, subtract the total inner part — that is first totality;
translations.idiomatic: For a total lunar eclipse, subtract the total inner part to obtain first totality;

sentences.zh: 加之，為生光：即各得所求小餘。

translations.literal: Add it — that is light generation: then each obtains the sought minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: Add again to obtain light generation; each case then yields the required minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 如求時刻，依食甚術入之。

translations.literal: If seeking the hour mark, enter by the eclipse-greatest procedure.
translations.idiomatic: To find clock time, apply the eclipse-greatest procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月食更點法：置月食甚所入日晨分，倍之，減去七百二十九，餘五約之，為更法；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse watch-and-point method: set the day's dawn parts at lunar eclipse greatest, double them, subtract 729, five-reduce the remainder to make the watch method;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse watch and point: double the day's dawn parts at eclipse greatest, subtract 729, and five-reduce the remainder to obtain the watch method;

sentences.zh: 又五除之，為點法。

translations.literal: Again divide by five to make the point method.
translations.idiomatic: Divide again by five to obtain the point method.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更點：置虧初、食甚、復末小餘，在晨分已下加晨分，昏分已上減去昏分，餘以更法除之為更數，不滿，以點法除之為點數。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse entry into watch and point: set first diminishment, eclipse greatest, and restoration-end minor remainders; below dawn parts add dawn parts, above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; divide the remainder by the watch method for watch count; what does not fill, divide by the point method for point count.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse watch and point entry: set first diminishment, greatest eclipse, and restoration-end minor remainders; below dawn parts add dawn parts, above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; divide the remainder by the watch method for watch count, then by the point method for point count.

sentences.zh: 其更數命初更，算外，即各得所入更、點。

translations.literal: Name the watch count from the first watch, outside the count — then each obtains its entered watch and point.
translations.idiomatic: Name from the first watch outside the count to obtain each entered watch and point.

sentences.zh: 求日食所起：日在陽曆，初起西南，甚于正南，復于東南；

translations.literal: To find where the solar eclipse begins: when the sun is in the yang calendar, first contact southwest, maximum due south, recovery southeast;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar eclipse direction of first contact: with the sun in the yang half, first contact is southwest, maximum due south, and recovery southeast;

sentences.zh: 日在陰曆，初起西北，甚於正北，復于東北。

translations.literal: When the sun is in the yin calendar, first contact northwest, maximum due north, recovery northeast.
translations.idiomatic: With the sun in the yin half, first contact is northwest, maximum due north, and recovery northeast.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上，皆起正西，復於正東。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due west and recover due east.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due west and recovery due east.

sentences.zh: 此據午地而論之。

translations.literal: This is discussed with reference to a noon-location observer.
translations.idiomatic: This assumes an observer on the local meridian (noon location).

sentences.zh: 求月食所起：月在陽曆，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北；

translations.literal: To find where the lunar eclipse begins: when the moon is in the yang calendar, first contact northeast, maximum due north, recovery northwest;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse direction of first contact: with the moon in the yang half, first contact is northeast, maximum due north, and recovery northwest;

sentences.zh: 月在陰曆，初起東南，甚于正南，復於西南。

translations.literal: When the moon is in the yin calendar, first contact southeast, maximum due south, recovery southwest.
translations.idiomatic: With the moon in the yin half, first contact is southeast, maximum due south, and recovery southwest.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上，皆起正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due east and recover due west.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due east and recovery due west.

sentences.zh: 此亦據午地而論之。

translations.literal: This too is discussed with reference to a noon-location observer.
translations.idiomatic: This also assumes an observer on the local meridian.

sentences.zh: 求日月出入帶食所見分數：各以食甚小餘與日出、入分相減，餘為帶食差；

translations.literal: To find the fraction of sun and moon visible at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse: for each, set the eclipse-greatest minor remainder and subtract the sun's rise or set parts; the remainder is the horizon-partial-eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the visible fraction when an eclipse is caught at sunrise or sunset: subtract rise or set parts from eclipse-greatest minor remainder to obtain the horizon-partial difference;

sentences.zh: 以乘所食之分，滿定用分而一，如月食既者，以既內分減帶食差，餘進一位，如既外分而一，所得，以減既分，即月帶食出入所見之分，不及減者，為帶食既出入。

translations.literal: Multiply by the fraction eclipsed, one per fixed use-part; when the lunar eclipse is total, subtract the total inner part from the horizon-partial-eclipse difference, advance the remainder one place, one per total outer part; use the result to subtract from the totality fraction — that is the moon's visible fraction at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse; when it cannot be fully subtracted, it is partial totality at rise or set.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the eclipsed fraction and divide by the fixed use-part; for total lunar eclipse, subtract the total inner part from the horizon-partial difference, advance the remainder one place, divide by the total outer part, subtract the result from the totality fraction to obtain the moon's visible fraction at rise or set; if subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is partially total at rise or set.

sentences.zh: 以減所食分，即日月出、入帶食所見之分。

translations.literal: Subtract that from the fraction eclipsed — that is the sun and moon visible fraction at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the result from the eclipsed fraction to obtain the visible fraction at rise or set for sun or moon with horizon partial eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其食甚在晝，晨為漸進，昏為已退；

translations.literal: When eclipse greatest falls in daytime, dawn means still advancing and dusk means already retreating;
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is in daylight, at dawn the eclipse is still advancing and at dusk it has already retreated;

sentences.zh: 其食甚在夜，晨為已退，昏為漸進。

translations.literal: When eclipse greatest falls at night, dawn means already retreating and dusk means still advancing.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is at night, at dawn it has already retreated and at dusk it is still advancing.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚宿次：置食甚日行積度，望即更加半周天。

translations.literal: To find sun and moon eclipse-greatest lodge sequence: set the eclipse-greatest daily-motion accumulated degrees; at full moon add half a circuit of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: To find eclipse-greatest lodge position: set daily-motion accumulated degrees at eclipse greatest; at full moon add half a circuit of heaven.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即各得日、月食甚宿度及分。

translations.literal: Add to the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree, add and name — then each obtains sun and moon eclipse-greatest lodge degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition, name the lodges, and obtain sun and moon eclipse-greatest lodge degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 步五星

translations.literal: Step Five Planets
translations.idiomatic: Step Five Planets

sentences.zh: 木星周率：二百九十萬七千八百七十九、秒六十四。

translations.literal: Jupiter circuit rate: 2,907,879, 64 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter circuit rate: 2,907,879, 64 seconds.

sentences.zh: 周差：二十四萬五千二百五十三、秒六十四。

translations.literal: Circuit difference: 245,253, 64 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit difference: 245,253, 64 seconds.

sentences.zh: 曆率：二百六十六萬二千六百三十六、秒二十二。

translations.literal: Calendar rate: 2,662,636, 22 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar rate: 2,662,636, 22 seconds.

sentences.zh: 周日：三百九十八、約分八十八、秒六十。
