sentences.zh: 推五星天正冬至後平合及諸段中積中星：置氣積分，各以其星周率除之，所得周數。

translations.literal: To compute the five planets' mean conjunction after civil new-year winter solstice and each segment's central accumulation and central star: set the qi accumulated parts; for each divide by that star's circuit rate — the result is the circuit count.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction after civil new-year winter solstice and the central accumulation and central star for every segment: set the qi accumulated parts, divide each by that star's circuit rate, and obtain the circuit count.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，為前合。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is the anterior conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the anterior conjunction.

sentences.zh: 以減周率，余滿日法為日，不滿，退除為分、秒，即其星天正冬至後平合中積；

translations.literal: Subtract from the circuit rate; the remainder filling the day divisor is days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds — that is the star's mean-conjunction central accumulation after civil new-year winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the circuit rate; convert the remainder to days by the day divisor, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain that star's mean-conjunction central accumulation after civil new-year winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 命之為平合中星，以諸段常日、常度累加之，即諸段中積、中星。

translations.literal: Name it the mean-conjunction central star; accumulate each segment's standard days and standard degrees — that yields each segment's central accumulation and central star.
translations.idiomatic: Name the result the mean-conjunction central star; add each segment's standard days and degrees cumulatively to obtain every segment's central accumulation and central star.

sentences.zh: 其段退行者，以常度減之，即其段中星。

translations.literal: For segments in retrograde motion, subtract the standard degree — that is the segment's central star.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments, subtract the standard degree to obtain the segment's central star.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星平合諸段入曆：置其星周數，求冬至後合，皆加一數置之。

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn mean-conjunction and each segment's entry into the calendar cycle: set that star's circuit count; for winter-solstice posterior conjunction, in each case add one to the count and set it.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean-conjunction entry into the calendar cycle for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn and each segment: set that star's circuit count, and for post-winter-solstice conjunction add one to the count.

sentences.zh: 以周差乘之，滿其星曆率去之，不盡，滿日法為度，不滿，退除為分、秒，即為其星平合入曆度及分、秒。

translations.literal: Multiply by the circuit difference; when full cast out that star's calendar rate; what does not exhaust, when it fills the day divisor is degrees, what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds — that is the star's mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the circuit difference, cast out full calendar rates, convert the remainder to degrees by the day divisor, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain the star's mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 以其段限度依次累加之，即得諸段入曆。

translations.literal: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively in sequence — that yields each segment's entry into the calendar cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively in order to obtain every segment's entry into the calendar cycle.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星平合及諸段入曆：置氣積分，各以其星曆率去之，不盡，滿日法除之為度，不滿，退除為分、秒，以加平合中星，即為其星天正冬至後平合入曆度及分、秒；

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury mean conjunction and each segment's entry into the calendar cycle: set the qi accumulated parts; for each cast out that star's calendar rate; what does not exhaust, divide by the day divisor for degrees, what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds; add to the mean-conjunction central star — that is the star's mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds after civil new-year winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: To find Venus and Mercury mean conjunction and each segment's entry into the calendar cycle: set the qi accumulated parts, cast out full calendar rates for each star, convert the remainder to degrees and parts and seconds, add to the mean-conjunction central star, and obtain mean-conjunction entry-into-calendar degree and parts and seconds after civil new-year winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 以其星其段限度依次累加之，即得諸段入曆。

translations.literal: Add that star's each segment limit degree cumulatively in sequence — that yields each segment's entry into the calendar cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Add that star's segment limit degrees cumulatively in order to obtain every segment's entry into the calendar cycle.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段盈縮定差：各置其星其段入曆度及分，如曆中已下為在盈；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference: for each set that star and segment's entry-into-calendar degree and parts; at or below the calendar mid is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference: set each star and segment's entry-into-calendar degree and parts; at or below the calendar mid counts as excess;

sentences.zh: 已上減去曆中，餘為在縮；

translations.literal: If above, subtract the calendar mid; the remainder lies in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: If above the calendar mid, subtract it; the remainder is in deficit.

sentences.zh: 以其星曆策除之為策數，不盡，為入策度及分；

translations.literal: Divide by that star's calendar stride for the stride count; what does not exhaust is the entry-into-stride degree and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Divide by that star's calendar stride to obtain the stride count; the remainder is entry-into-stride degree and parts;

sentences.zh: 命策數，算外，以其策損益率乘之，如曆策而一為分，分滿百為度；

translations.literal: Name the stride count, outside the count; multiply the loss-and-gain rate below that stride, one per calendar stride for parts; when parts fill 100 they become degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Name from outside the stride count, multiply the tabulated loss-and-gain rate for that stride, divide by the calendar stride for parts, and convert parts filling 100 to degrees;

sentences.zh: 以損益其下盈縮積，即其星其段盈縮定差。

translations.literal: Apply it to the excess-and-deficit accumulation below — that is that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Apply it to the underlying excess-and-deficit accumulation to obtain that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段定積：各置其星其段中積，以其段盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即其段定積日及分；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's fixed accumulation: for each set that star and segment's central accumulation; add when in excess and subtract when in deficit by the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference — that is the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's fixed accumulation: set each star and segment's central accumulation, add or subtract the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference according to excess or deficit, and obtain the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至大餘及約分加之，即為定日及分；

translations.literal: Add the civil new-year winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts — that is the fixed day and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add the civil new-year winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts to obtain the fixed day and parts;

sentences.zh: 盈紀法六十去之，不盡，命己卯，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: When full cast out the era rule of 60; what does not exhaust, name from jimao outside the count — that yields the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full era rules of 60, name from jimao outside the count, and obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合諸段所在月日：各置其段定積，以天正閏日及約分加之，滿朔策及約分除之為月數，不盡，為入月已來日數及分。

translations.literal: To find the month and day where each planet's mean-conjunction segments fall: for each set that segment's fixed accumulation; add the civil new-year intercalary days and approximate parts; when full divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count; what does not exhaust is the days and parts elapsed within the month.
translations.idiomatic: To find the month and day for each planet's mean-conjunction segments: set each segment's fixed accumulation, add civil new-year intercalary days and approximate parts, divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count, and take the remainder as days and parts elapsed within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數命天正十一月，算外，即其星其段入其月經朔日數及分，乃以日辰相距為定朔月、日。

translations.literal: Name the month count from civil new-year month eleven outside the count — that is the star and segment's days and parts since that month's mean new moon; then the interval of day and double-hour is the fixed new-moon month and day.
translations.idiomatic: Name the month count from civil new-year month eleven outside the count to obtain the segment's days and parts since mean new moon, and take the day-and-double-hour interval as the fixed new-moon month and day.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及諸段加時定星：各置其段中星，以其段盈縮定差盈加縮減之，金星倍之水星三之，乃可加減。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's hour-of-addition fixed star: for each set that segment's central star; add when in excess and subtract when in deficit by the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference — for Venus double it and for Mercury triple it, then one may add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's hour-of-addition fixed star: set each segment's central star, apply the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference (double for Venus, triple for Mercury), then add or subtract according to excess or deficit.

sentences.zh: 即五星諸段定星；

translations.literal: That yields the five planets' each segment fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: That yields each planet's segment fixed star;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其星其段加時所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add to the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree, add and name — that is the star and segment's hour-of-addition lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition, name the lodges, and obtain that star and segment's hour-of-addition lodge degree, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 五星皆因前留為前段初日定星，後留為後段初日定星，餘依術算。

translations.literal: The five planets all take the anterior station as the anterior segment's first-day fixed star and the posterior station as the posterior segment's first-day fixed star; the remainder follows the procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For all five planets, the anterior station fixes the first-day star of the anterior segment and the posterior station the first-day star of the posterior segment; compute the remainder by the procedure.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段初日晨前夜半定星：各以其段初行率乘其段加時分，百約之，乃以順減退加其日加時定星，即為其段初日晨前夜半定星；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' each segment first-day before-dawn midnight fixed star: for each multiply that segment's initial motion rate by that segment's hour-of-addition parts, hundred-reduce it, then for direct motion subtract and for retrograde add to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star — that is the segment's first-day before-dawn midnight fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's first-day before-dawn midnight fixed star for every segment: multiply the segment's initial motion rate by its hour-of-addition parts and hundred-reduce, then subtract for direct motion or add for retrograde from that day's hour-of-addition fixed star to obtain the segment's first-day before-dawn midnight fixed star;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得所求。

translations.literal: Add and name as before — that yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name as before to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求諸段日率度率：各以其段日辰距至後段日辰，為其段日率；

translations.literal: To find each segment's day rate and degree rate: for each take that segment's day-and-double-hour interval to the next segment's day and double-hour — that is the segment's day rate;
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's day rate and degree rate: for each take the day-and-double-hour interval from that segment to the next segment as the segment's day rate;

sentences.zh: 以其段夜半定星與後段夜半定星相減，為其段度率及分秒。

translations.literal: Subtract that segment's midnight fixed star from the next segment's midnight fixed star — that is the segment's degree rate and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract that segment's midnight fixed star from the next segment's midnight fixed star to obtain the segment's degree rate, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求諸段平行度：各置其段度率及分秒，以其段日率除之，為其段平行度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find each segment's parallel degree: for each set that segment's degree rate and parts and seconds, divide by that segment's day rate — that is the segment's parallel degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's parallel degree: set each segment's degree rate, parts, and seconds, divide by its day rate, and obtain the segment's parallel degree, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求諸段總差：各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為泛差；

translations.literal: To find each segment's total difference: for each subtract that segment's parallel parts from the next segment's parallel parts; the remainder is the general difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's total difference: subtract each segment's parallel parts from the next segment's parallel parts; the remainder is the general difference;

sentences.zh: 並前段泛差，四因，退一位，為總差。

translations.literal: Combine with the anterior segment's general difference, multiply by four, retreat one place — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the previous segment's general difference, multiply by four, and shift one decimal place to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若前段無平行分相減為泛差者，因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減，餘為半總差；

translations.literal: If the anterior segment has no parallel parts to subtract for a general difference, subtract that segment's parallel parts from the posterior segment's first-day motion parts; the remainder is half the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: When the prior segment lacks parallel parts for subtraction, subtract that segment's parallel parts from the next segment's first-day motion parts; the remainder is half the total difference;

sentences.zh: 倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: Double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若後段無平行分相減為泛差者，因前段末日行分與其段平行分相減，餘為半總差，倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: If the posterior segment has no parallel parts to subtract for a general difference, subtract that segment's parallel parts from the anterior segment's last-day motion parts; the remainder is half the total difference; double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the following segment lacks parallel parts for subtraction, subtract that segment's parallel parts from the previous segment's last-day motion parts; double the half-total difference to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 晨遲末段，視段無平行分，因前初段末日行分與晨遲末段平行分相減，為半總差；

translations.literal: For the morning-slow final segment, if the segment has no parallel parts, subtract the morning-slow final segment's parallel parts from the anterior initial segment's last-day motion parts — that is half the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: For the morning-slow final segment, when parallel parts are absent, subtract its parallel parts from the previous initial segment's last-day motion parts to obtain half the total difference;

sentences.zh: 其退行者，各置本段平行分，十四乘之，十五而一，為總差。

translations.literal: For those in retrograde motion, for each set that segment's parallel parts, multiply by fourteen, divide by fifteen — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments, set each segment's parallel parts, multiply by fourteen and divide by fifteen to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 內金星依順段術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: For Mercury, enter by the direct-segment procedure — that yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, apply the direct-segment procedure to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 夕遲初段，視前段無平行分，因後末段初日行分與夕遲初段平行分相減，為半總差。

translations.literal: For the evening-slow initial segment, if the anterior segment has no parallel parts, subtract the evening-slow initial segment's parallel parts from the posterior final segment's first-day motion parts — that is half the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: For the evening-slow initial segment, when the prior segment lacks parallel parts, subtract its parallel parts from the next final segment's first-day motion parts to obtain half the total difference.

sentences.zh: 求諸段初末日行分：各半其段總差，加減其段平行分，後段平行分多者，減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: To find each segment's first- and last-day motion parts: for each halve that segment's total difference, add or subtract that segment's parallel parts; when the posterior segment's parallel parts are greater, subtract for the initial and add for the final;
translations.idiomatic: To find each segment's first- and last-day motion parts: halve the segment's total difference and add or subtract its parallel parts; when the next segment's parallel parts are greater, subtract for the first day and add for the last;

sentences.zh: 後段平行分少者，加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: When the posterior segment's parallel parts are fewer, add for the initial and subtract for the final.
translations.idiomatic: When the next segment's parallel parts are fewer, add for the first day and subtract for the last.

sentences.zh: 其在退行者，前減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: For those in retrograde motion, subtract for the initial and add for the final;
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion, subtract for the first day and add for the last;

sentences.zh: 後加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: for the posterior, add for the initial and subtract for the final.
translations.idiomatic: for the following segment, add for the first day and subtract for the last.

sentences.zh: 各為其星其段初、末日行度及分秒。

translations.literal: Each becomes that star and that segment's first- and last-day motion degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields that star's first- and last-day motion degrees, parts, and seconds for the segment.

sentences.zh: 如前後段平行分俱多、俱少者，平注之；

translations.literal: As when anterior and posterior segments' parallel parts are both greater or both fewer, level and distribute;
translations.idiomatic: When both adjacent segments' parallel parts are greater or both are fewer, distribute evenly;

sentences.zh: 本段總差不滿大分者，亦平注之。

translations.literal: When this segment's total difference does not fill a major part, also level and distribute.
translations.idiomatic: When a segment's total difference is less than one major part, distribute evenly as well.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次：置其段總差，減日率一以除之，為日差；

translations.literal: To find each day's before-dawn midnight star motion lodge sequence: set that segment's total difference, subtract one from the day rate and divide by it — that is the day difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge position at each day's before-dawn midnight: set the segment's total difference, divide by the day rate minus one, and obtain the day difference;

sentences.zh: 累損益初日行分，後行分少，損之；

translations.literal: Accumulate diminishing and increasing the first-day motion parts; when later motion parts are fewer, diminish;
translations.idiomatic: Adjust the first-day motion parts cumulatively; when later motion parts decrease, subtract;

sentences.zh: 後行分多，益之。

translations.literal: when later motion parts are more, increase.
translations.idiomatic: when later motion parts increase, add.

sentences.zh: 為每日行度及分秒；

translations.literal: That becomes each day's motion degree and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: This yields each day's motion in degrees, parts, and seconds;

sentences.zh: 乃順加退減其段初日晨前夜半宿次命之，即每日晨前夜半星行所在宿次。

translations.literal: Then for direct motion add and for retrograde subtract from that segment's first-day before-dawn midnight lodge sequence and name — that is each day's before-dawn midnight star motion lodge.
translations.idiomatic: For direct motion add and for retrograde subtract from the segment's first-day lodge at before-dawn midnight, naming each in turn to obtain the lodge at every day's before-dawn midnight.

sentences.zh: 徑求其日宿次：置所求日，減一，半之，以日差乘而加減初行日分，後行分少，減之；

translations.literal: To find directly that day's lodge sequence: set the day sought, subtract one, halve it, multiply by the day difference and add or subtract to the initial-day motion parts; when later motion parts are fewer, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: To find a given day's lodge directly: take the requested day minus one, halve it, multiply by the day difference and add or subtract from the initial motion parts; subtract when later motion parts are fewer;

sentences.zh: 後行分多，加之。

translations.literal: when later motion parts are more, add.
translations.idiomatic: add when later motion parts are greater.

sentences.zh: 以所求日乘之，為積度；

translations.literal: Multiply by the day sought — that is the accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the requested day to obtain accumulated degrees;

sentences.zh: 乃順加退減其段初日宿次，即得所求日宿次。

translations.literal: Then for direct motion add and for retrograde subtract from that segment's first-day lodge sequence — that yields the day sought's lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Add for direct motion or subtract for retrograde from the segment's first-day lodge to obtain the lodge for the requested day.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合及見伏入氣：置定積，以氣策及約分除之為氣數，不盡，為入氣已來日數及分秒。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance-hiding entry into qi: set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi policy and approximate parts for the qi count; what does not exhaust is the days and parts and seconds elapsed since entering qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mean conjunction and appearance or occultation entry into a qi period: set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi policy and approximate parts for the qi count, and take the remainder as days, parts, and seconds since qi entry.

sentences.zh: 其氣數命天正冬至，算外，即五星平合及見、伏入氣日及分秒。

translations.literal: Name the qi count from civil new-year winter solstice, outside the count — that is the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance and hiding qi-entry day and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Count the qi from civil new-year winter solstice to obtain each planet's mean conjunction and appearance or hiding qi-entry day, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 其定積滿歲周日及分，去之，餘，在來年冬至後。

translations.literal: When the fixed accumulation fills the year's circuit day and parts, remove it; the remainder lies after next year's winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed accumulation exceeds a full year's circuit, discard the excess; the remainder falls after the following year's winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 求五星合見伏行差：木、火、土三星，以其段初日星行分減太陽行分，餘為行差。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' conjunction appearance-hiding motion difference: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract the sun's motion parts from that segment's first-day star motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find motion difference at conjunction, appearance, or occultation: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract the sun's motion parts from the segment's first-day planetary motion parts.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星順行者，以其段初日太陽行分減星行分，餘為行差。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in direct motion, subtract the star's motion parts from that segment's first-day sun motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in direct motion, subtract the planet's motion parts from the sun's motion parts on the segment's first day.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星退行者，以其段初日星行分並太陽行分，為行差。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde motion, combine that segment's first-day star motion parts with the sun's motion parts — that is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde motion, add the planet's and sun's motion parts on the segment's first day.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合及見伏泛積：木、火、土三星，各以平合晨疾、夕伏定積，便為定合定見、定伏泛積。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction and appearance-hiding general accumulation: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each take the mean-conjunction morning-swift and evening-hidden fixed accumulation — that directly becomes the fixed-conjunction fixed-appearance and fixed-hiding general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed conjunction and appearance or occultation general accumulations: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, use the mean-conjunction morning-swift and evening-hidden fixed accumulations directly as the fixed conjunction, appearance, and occultation general accumulations.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星，各置其段盈縮定差，內水星倍之，以其段行差除之為日，不滿，退除為分秒，在平合夕疾、晨伏者，乃盈減縮加定積，為定合定見、定伏泛積；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, for each set that segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference; for Mercury double it; divide by that segment's motion difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds; for those at mean conjunction evening-swift and morning-hidden, then in excess diminish and in deficit add to the fixed accumulation — that is the fixed-conjunction fixed-appearance and fixed-hiding general accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, set each segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference (double for Mercury), divide by the segment's motion difference for days and convert the remainder to parts and seconds; at mean conjunction evening-swift and morning-hidden, subtract excess or add deficit to the fixed accumulation;

sentences.zh: 在退合夕伏、晨見者，用盈加縮減定積，為定合定見、定伏泛積。

translations.literal: For those at retrograde conjunction evening-hidden and morning-appearance, use excess to add and deficit to subtract from the fixed accumulation — that is the fixed-conjunction fixed-appearance and fixed-hiding general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: At retrograde conjunction evening-hidden and morning-appearance, add excess or subtract deficit from the fixed accumulation for the fixed conjunction, appearance, and occultation general accumulations.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定積定星：木、火、土三星，以平合行差除其日先後數，為距合差日；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by the mean-conjunction motion difference — that is the conjunction-interval difference day;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed conjunction accumulation and fixed star: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-interval difference in days;

sentences.zh: 以先後數減之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: subtract the prior-and-posterior count — that is the conjunction-interval difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the prior-and-posterior count to obtain the conjunction-interval difference in degrees;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度後加先減其星定合泛積，為其星定合日定積、定星。

translations.literal: With difference day and difference degree, add the posterior and subtract the anterior from that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation — that is the star's fixed-conjunction day fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Add the difference day and degree posteriorly and subtract anteriorly from the planet's fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain fixed-conjunction day, accumulation, and star.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星順合者，以平合行差除其日先後數，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in direct conjunction, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by the mean-conjunction motion difference — that is the conjunction-interval difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in direct conjunction, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by mean-conjunction motion difference for conjunction-interval difference days;

sentences.zh: 以先後數加之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: add the prior-and-posterior count — that is the conjunction-interval difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: add the prior-and-posterior count for conjunction-interval difference degrees;

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度先加後減其星定合泛積，為其星定合日定積、定星。

translations.literal: With difference day and difference degree, add the anterior and subtract the posterior from that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation — that is the star's fixed-conjunction day fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Add difference day and degree anteriorly and subtract posteriorly from the planet's fixed-conjunction general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星退合者，以退合行差除其日先後數，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by the retrograde-conjunction motion difference — that is the conjunction-interval difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by retrograde-conjunction motion difference;

sentences.zh: 以減先後數，為距合差度；

translations.literal: subtract the prior-and-posterior count — that is the conjunction-interval difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the prior-and-posterior count for conjunction-interval difference degrees;

sentences.zh: 以差日先減後加，以差度先加後減再定合泛積，為其星再定合積星。

translations.literal: With difference day first subtract then add, with difference degree first add then subtract from the re-fixed-conjunction general accumulation — that is the star's re-fixed-conjunction accumulation and star.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract then add the difference day and add then subtract the difference degree from the re-fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain re-fixed conjunction accumulation and star.

sentences.zh: 各以冬至大餘及約分加定積，滿紀法去之，命己卯，算外，即得定合日辰；

translations.literal: For each add winter solstice great remainder and approximate parts to the fixed accumulation; when full remove by the era divisor; name from jimao, outside the count — that yields the fixed-conjunction day and double-hour;
translations.idiomatic: Add winter solstice great remainder and approximate parts to each fixed accumulation, cast out full era cycles, count from jimao, and obtain the fixed-conjunction day and double-hour;

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時黃道日度加定星，依宿次去之，即得定合所在宿次。

translations.literal: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree, remove by lodge sequence — that yields the fixed conjunction's lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition and name the lodges to obtain the fixed conjunction's lodge position.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星定見伏定積日：各置其星定見、伏泛積，晨加夕減象限日及分秒，如二至限已下自相乘，已上，覆減歲周，餘亦自相乘，百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除之，為差；

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn fixed appearance-hiding fixed-accumulation day: for each set that star's fixed appearance-hiding general accumulation; for morning add and for evening subtract image-limit days and parts and seconds; if at or below the two-solstice limit, self-multiply, if above, overturn-subtract year circuit, remainder also self-multiply, hundred-reduce for parts, multiply by that star's hiding-appearance degree, divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed appearance and occultation days for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn: set each planet's general accumulation, add for morning appearances and subtract for evening occultations according to the image limit, apply the two-solstice limit formula, multiply by visibility degree and divide by fifteen for the difference;

sentences.zh: 其差如其段行差而一為日，不滿，退除為分、秒，見加伏減泛積，為定積；

translations.literal: The difference, as one to that segment's motion difference, becomes days; what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds; for appearance add and for hiding subtract from the general accumulation — that is the fixed accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Convert the difference to days at the segment's motion difference rate, remainder to parts and seconds, add for appearance and subtract for occultation from the general accumulation;

sentences.zh: 如前加命，即得日辰。

translations.literal: Add and name as before — that yields the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Name as before to obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星定見伏定日：夕見、晨伏，以行差除其日先後數，為日；

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury fixed appearance-hiding fixed day: for evening appearance and morning hiding, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by the motion difference — that is days;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed appearance and occultation days for Venus and Mercury: for evening appearance and morning occultation, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by motion difference;

sentences.zh: 先加後減泛用積，為常用積。

translations.literal: add the anterior and subtract the posterior from the general-use accumulation — that is the regular-use accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: add anteriorly and subtract posteriorly from the general-use accumulation for the regular-use accumulation.

sentences.zh: 晨見、夕伏，以行差除其日先後數，為日；

translations.literal: for morning appearance and evening hiding, divide the day-prior-and-posterior count by the motion difference — that is days;
translations.idiomatic: for morning appearance and evening occultation, divide by motion difference for days;

sentences.zh: 先減後加泛用積，為常用積。

translations.literal: subtract the anterior and add the posterior to the general-use accumulation — that is the regular-use accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: subtract anteriorly and add posteriorly from the general-use accumulation.

sentences.zh: 如常用積在二至限已下為冬至後；

translations.literal: If the regular-use accumulation is at or below the two-solstice limit, it is after winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: If the regular-use accumulation is at or below the two-solstice limit, count it as after winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 已上去之，餘為夏至後。

translations.literal: if above, remove it; the remainder is after summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the limit; the remainder is after summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 其二至後日及分在象限已下自相乘，已上，用減二至限，餘亦自相乘，如法而一，所得為分；

translations.literal: For days and parts after a solstice, if at or below the image limit self-multiply, if above subtract from the two-solstice limit, remainder also self-multiply, divide per the method for one — the result is parts;
translations.idiomatic: For days and parts after a solstice, self-multiply if at or below the image limit, otherwise subtract from the two-solstice limit and self-multiply the remainder; divide per the method for parts;

sentences.zh: 冬至後晨，夏至後夕，以十八為法；

translations.literal: after winter solstice for morning, after summer solstice for evening, use eighteen as divisor;
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice for morning, after summer solstice for evening, use eighteen as divisor;

sentences.zh: 冬至後夕、夏至後晨，以七十五為法。

translations.literal: after winter solstice for evening, after summer solstice for morning, use seventy-five as divisor.
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice for evening, after summer solstice for morning, use seventy-five as divisor.

sentences.zh: 以伏見度乘之、十五除之，為差；

translations.literal: multiply by the hiding-appearance degree and divide by fifteen — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the occultation-appearance degree and divide by fifteen for the difference;

sentences.zh: 滿行差而一為日，不滿，退除為分秒，加減常用積，為定用積；

translations.literal: When full divide by motion difference for days, what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds, add or subtract from regular-use accumulation — that is the fixed-use accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: When full divide by motion difference for days, remainder to parts and seconds, add or subtract from regular-use accumulation for fixed-use accumulation;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得定見、伏日辰。

translations.literal: Add and name as before — that yields the fixed appearance and hiding day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Name as before to obtain fixed appearance and occultation day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 冬至後，晨見、夕伏加之，夕見、晨伏減之；

translations.literal: After winter solstice, for morning appearance and evening hiding add; for evening appearance and morning hiding subtract;
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice, add for morning appearance and evening occultation, subtract for evening appearance and morning occultation;

sentences.zh: 夏至後，晨見、夕伏減之，夕見、晨伏加之。

translations.literal: after summer solstice, for morning appearance and evening hiding subtract; for evening appearance and morning hiding add.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, subtract for morning appearance and evening occultation, add for evening appearance and morning occultation.

sentences.zh: 其水星，夕疾在大暑氣初日至立冬氣九日三十五分已下者，不見；

translations.literal: For Mercury, when evening-swift falls from Great Heat qi initial day through Lesser Snow qi day nine and thirty-five parts and below, it is not seen;
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, when evening-swift falls from the start of Great Heat qi through day nine and thirty-five parts of Lesser Snow qi, it is invisible;

sentences.zh: 晨留在大寒氣初日至立夏氣九日三十五分已下者，春不晨見，秋不夕見。

translations.literal: when morning-station falls from Great Cold qi initial day through Start of Summer qi day nine and thirty-five parts and below, in spring it is not seen in the morning, in autumn not in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: When morning-station falls from the start of Great Cold qi through day nine and thirty-five parts of Start of Summer qi, Mercury does not appear in the morning in spring or in the evening in autumn.

sentences.zh: 熙寧六年六月，提舉司天監陳繹言：「渾儀尺度與《法要》不合，二極、赤道四分不均，規、環左右距度不對，遊儀重澀難運，黃道映蔽橫簫，遊規璺裂，黃道不合天體，天樞內極星不見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, sixth year of Xining, Chen Yi, supervisor of the Directorate of Astronomy, said: "The armillary sphere's scale does not match the Essentials of Methods; the two poles and the four quarters of the equator are uneven; the reguli and rings' left-right inter-hole degrees do not align; the touring instrument is heavy and sluggish and hard to turn; the ecliptic is obstructed by the transverse lath; the touring rule is cracked; the ecliptic does not match the celestial body; the pole star within the celestial pivot is not visible.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year of Xining, Chen Yi, supervisor of the Directorate of Astronomy, reported: "The armillary sphere's measurements do not agree with the Essentials of Methods. The two poles and the equator's four quarters are uneven, the distance graduations on the rings do not match left and right, the sighting arm is too heavy to turn smoothly, the ecliptic band is blocked by the crossbeam, the touring sight-ring is cracked, the ecliptic fails to align with the heavens, and the pole star within the celestial pivot cannot be seen.

sentences.zh: 天文院渾儀尺度及二極、赤道四分各不均，黃道、天常環、月道映蔽橫簫，及月道不與天合，天常環相攻難轉，天樞內極星不見。

translations.literal: The Astronomical Bureau armillary sphere's scale and the two poles and equator's four quarters are each uneven; the ecliptic, celestial constant ring, and lunar path obstruct the transverse lath, and the lunar path does not match heaven; the celestial constant ring clashes and is hard to turn; the pole star within the celestial pivot is not visible.
translations.idiomatic: The Astronomical Bureau's armillary sphere likewise has uneven scales on the two poles and equator, while the ecliptic, celestial constant ring, and lunar path block the crossbeam; the lunar path fails to match the heavens, the celestial constant ring binds and turns with difficulty, and the pole star within the celestial pivot remains unseen.

sentences.zh: 皆當因舊修整，新定渾儀，改用古尺，均賦辰度，規、環輕利，黃赤道、天常環並側置，以北際當天度，省去月道，令不蔽橫蕭，增天樞為二度半，以納極星，規、環、二極，各設環樞，以便遊運。」

translations.literal: All should be repaired from the old, a newly fixed armillary sphere made, ancient feet used, lodge degrees evenly assigned, reguli and rings light and nimble, yellow and red equator and celestial constant ring both set on the side, the northern rim matching celestial degree, the lunar path omitted so as not to obstruct the transverse lath, the celestial pivot increased to two and a half degrees to admit the pole star, reguli, rings, and two poles each given ring pivots for convenient touring motion."
translations.idiomatic: Everything should be refurbished from the old instrument and recast as a new armillary sphere using ancient foot-lengths, with lodge degrees evenly marked, rings made light and easy to move, the ecliptic and equator and celestial constant ring set on edge with the northern rim aligned to celestial degree, the lunar path removed so it no longer blocks the crossbeam, the celestial pivot widened to two and a half degrees to take in the pole star, and pivots added to the rings and poles so the sighting arm may travel freely.

sentences.zh: 詔依新式製造，置於司天監測驗，以較疏密。

translations.literal: An edict ordered manufacture according to the new style, placed at the Directorate of Astronomy for testing, to compare coarse and fine.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered manufacture in the new design and placement at the Directorate of Astronomy for trial, to compare coarse and fine readings.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，司天監呈新制渾儀、浮漏于迎陽門，帝召輔臣觀之，數問同提舉官沈括，具對所以改更之理。

translations.literal: Sixth month, seventh year, the Directorate of Astronomy presented the newly made armillary sphere and clepsydra at the Gate Facing the Sun; the emperor summoned assisting ministers to view them and repeatedly questioned co-supervisor Shen Kuo, who fully answered the reasons for the alterations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year, the Directorate presented the new armillary sphere and clepsydra at the Gate Facing the Sun. The emperor summoned his chief ministers to inspect them and questioned Shen Kuo, co-supervisor of the project, again and again; Kuo explained in full the rationale behind every change.

sentences.zh: 尋又言：「准詔，集監官較其疏密，無可比較。」

translations.literal: Soon they also said: "Per the edict, the directorate officers were assembled to compare coarse and fine; there was nothing comparable."
translations.idiomatic: They soon reported further: "As the edict directed, directorate officers were gathered to compare the old and new instruments for accuracy, but no valid comparison could be made."

sentences.zh: 詔置於翰林天文院。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them placed in the Hanlin Astronomical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the instruments installed in the Hanlin Astronomical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 七月，以括為右正言，司天秋官正皇甫愈等賞有差。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Kuo was made Right Remonstrator; Huangfu Yu, Autumn Office Director of the Directorate, and others were rewarded in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Shen Kuo was appointed Right Remonstrator, and Huangfu Yu, Autumn Office Director of the Directorate, among others received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 初，括上《渾儀》、《浮漏》、《景表》三議，見《天文志》。

translations.literal: Earlier, Kuo had submitted three memorials on the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and gnomon table — see the Astronomical Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Kuo had submitted three memorials on the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and gnomon table, recorded in the Astronomical Treatise.

sentences.zh: 朝延用其說，令改造法物、曆書。

translations.literal: The court adopted his proposals and ordered the refashioning of ritual instruments and calendrical books.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted his proposals and ordered the refashioning of ritual instruments and calendrical books.

sentences.zh: 至是，渾儀、浮漏成，故賞之。

translations.literal: By this time the armillary sphere and clepsydra were complete, hence the rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the armillary sphere and clepsydra were finished, rewards were granted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年正月，翰林學士王安禮言：「詳定渾儀官歐陽發所上渾儀、浮漏木樣，具新器之宜，變舊器之失，臣等竊詳司天監浮漏，疏謬不可用，請依新式改造。

translations.literal: First month, fifth year of Yuanfeng, Academician-Expositor Wang Anli said: "The officer for detailed determination of the armillary sphere, Ouyang Fa, submitted models of the armillary sphere and clepsydra in wood, setting forth the new instrument's advantages and correcting the old instrument's faults. We have privately examined the Directorate clepsydra — coarse and erroneous, unusable — and request reconstruction according to the new style.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Academician-Expositor Wang Anli reported: "Ouyang Fa, officer charged with determining the armillary sphere, has submitted wooden models of the armillary sphere and clepsydra that show what the new instruments should do and remedy what the old ones got wrong. We find the Directorate's clepsydra coarse and unreliable and ask that it be rebuilt to the new design.

sentences.zh: 其至道、皇祐渾儀、景表亦各差舛，請如法條奏修正。」

translations.literal: The Zhidao and Huangyou armillary spheres and gnomon tables also each differ and err; we request correction and memorial according to the statute.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhidao and Huangyou armillary spheres and gnomon tables are likewise defective; we ask that they be corrected and reported to the throne as the regulations provide."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年三月，翰林學士許將等言：「詳定元祐渾天儀象所先奉詔製造水運渾儀木樣，如試驗候天不差，即別造銅器，今校驗皆與天合。」

translations.literal: Third month, fourth year of Yuanyou, Academician-Expositor Xu Jiang and others said: "The office for detailed determination of the Yuanyou armillary sphere and celestial globe, having first received an edict to manufacture a water-driven armillary sphere model in wood — if trial observation against heaven showed no discrepancy, then separately cast bronze — now on verification all match heaven."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Yuanyou, Academician-Expositor Xu Jiang and others reported: "The office determining the Yuanyou armillary sphere and celestial globe, having first been ordered to build a water-driven wooden model — with bronze to follow if observations showed no error — has now verified that every reading agrees with the sky."

sentences.zh: 詔以銅造，仍以元祐渾天儀象為名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered casting in bronze, still taking the name Yuanyou Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered casting in bronze, retaining the name Yuanyou Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe.

sentences.zh: 將等又言：「前所謂渾天儀者，其外形圓，可遍佈星度；

translations.literal: Jiang and others also said: "What was formerly called the armillary sphere — its outer form is round and can spread star degrees everywhere;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and his colleagues added: "The instrument once called the armillary sphere has a round outer shell on which star degrees may be marked all around;

sentences.zh: 其內有璣、有衡，可仰窺天象。

translations.literal: within it has the ji and the heng, by which one can look up and spy out the heavenly image.
translations.idiomatic: inside are the ji and heng sighting components by which one peers up at the heavens.

sentences.zh: 今所建渾儀象，別為二器，而渾儀占測天度之真數，又以渾象置之密室，自為天運，與儀參合。

translations.literal: The armillary sphere and globe now built are made as two separate instruments, while the armillary sphere measures true celestial degrees and the celestial globe is also placed in a sealed chamber, turning of itself as heaven moves, coordinated with the sphere.
translations.idiomatic: The instruments now built split these into two: the armillary sphere measures true celestial degrees, while a celestial globe is placed in a sealed chamber and driven to revolve like the sky, coordinated with the sphere.

sentences.zh: 若並為一器，即象為儀，以同正天度，則渾天儀象兩得之矣。

translations.literal: If made as one instrument, the globe would be the sphere and share the same corrected celestial degrees — then one would obtain both armillary sphere and globe at once.
translations.idiomatic: If combined in one, the globe would serve as the sphere and share the same corrected celestial degrees — and the armillary sphere and celestial globe would be won in a single instrument.

sentences.zh: 請更作渾天儀。」

translations.literal: We request that a armillary-heaven sphere be made anew.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that a unified armillary-heaven instrument be made anew."

sentences.zh: 從之，七年四月，詔尚書左丞蘇頌撰《渾天儀象銘》。

translations.literal: The court assented; fourth month, seventh year, an edict ordered Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Song to compose the inscription for the Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed; in the fourth month of the seventh year an edict ordered Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Song to compose the inscription for the Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe.

sentences.zh: 六月，元祐渾天儀象成，詔三省、樞密院官閱之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the Yuanyou Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe were completed; an edict ordered officials of the Three Departments and Privy Council to inspect them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Yuanyou Armillary Sphere and Celestial Globe were completed, and officials of the Three Departments and Privy Council were summoned to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年十月，詔禮部、秘書省，即詳定制造渾天儀象所，以新舊渾儀集局官同測驗，擇其精密可用者以聞。

translations.literal: Tenth month, first year of Shaosheng, an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites and Secretariat, at the office for detailed manufacture of the armillary sphere and celestial globe, to have bureau officers test old and new armillary spheres together and report whichever is precise and usable.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Shaosheng, an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Secretariat, at the office manufacturing the armillary sphere and celestial globe, to have bureau officers test old and new armillary spheres together and report whichever proved precise and fit for use.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年七月，宰臣王黼言：

translations.literal: Seventh month, sixth year of Xuanhe, Chief Councillor Wang Fu said:
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xuanhe, Chief Councillor Wang Fu reported:

sentences.zh: 臣崇甯元年邂逅方外之士于京師，自雲王其姓，面出素書一，道璣衡之制甚詳。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongning I chanced upon a man beyond the world at the capital; he gave his surname as Wang and produced a plain book setting forth the ji-heng mechanism in great detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongning I met by chance at the capital a man from beyond the ordinary world who gave his surname as Wang and handed me an unadorned book describing the mechanism of the ji and heng in meticulous detail.

sentences.zh: 比嘗請令應奉司造小樣驗之，逾二月，乃成璿璣，其圓如丸，具三百六十五度四分度之一，置南北極、昆侖山及黃、赤二道，列二十四氣、七十二候、六十四卦、十幹、十二支、晝夜百刻，列二十八宿、並內外三垣、周天星。

translations.literal: I once asked the Service-for-the-Emperor Office to make a small model to test it; after more than two months the xuanji was completed — round as a pellet, bearing three hundred sixty-five and one-quarter degrees, with south and north poles, Mount Kunlun, and the yellow and red paths, arraying the twenty-four qi, seventy-two hou, sixty-four hexagrams, ten stems, twelve branches, day and night hundred ke, the twenty-eight lodges, and the inner and outer three enclosures with all stars of the circuit of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: I had the Service-for-the-Emperor Office build a small model to test it; after more than two months the xuanji was finished, round as a pellet and marked with three hundred sixty-five and a quarter degrees, bearing the south and north poles, Mount Kunlun, and the yellow and red paths, with the twenty-four qi, seventy-two hou, sixty-four hexagrams, ten stems, twelve branches, the hundred day-and-night marks, the twenty-eight lodges, and the inner and outer three enclosures with every star of the circuit of heaven.

sentences.zh: 日月循黃道天行，每天左旋一周，日右旋一度，冬至南出赤道二十四度，夏至北入赤道二十四度，春秋二分黃、赤道交而出卯入酉。

translations.literal: Sun and moon follow the ecliptic's heavenly motion; each day the heaven rotates left one circuit, the sun rotates right one degree; at winter solstice it emerges twenty-four degrees south of the equator, at summer solstice enters twenty-four degrees north of the equator; at spring and autumn equinoxes yellow and red paths cross and emerge at mao and enter at you.
translations.idiomatic: The sun and moon travel along the ecliptic's daily course: each day the sky wheels left one full turn while the sun wheels right one degree; at winter solstice it emerges twenty-four degrees south of the equator, at summer solstice it enters twenty-four degrees north, and at the spring and autumn equinoxes the yellow and red paths cross so it emerges at mao and sets at you.

sentences.zh: 月行十三度有餘，生明於西，其形如鉤，下環，西見半規，及望而圓；

translations.literal: The moon travels more than thirteen degrees; brightness is born in the west, its form like a hook, the lower ring — half a round visible in the west; at full it is round;
translations.idiomatic: The moon moves more than thirteen degrees a day; its light is born in the west, first shaped like a hook with the lower arc — a half-disk seen in the west — until at full it is round;

sentences.zh: 既望，西缺下環，東見半規，及晦而隱。

translations.literal: after full, the west is deficient in the lower ring, the east shows half a round; at last it hides.
translations.idiomatic: after full the western arc is cut away in the lower ring while the eastern half-disk appears, until at last it vanishes.

sentences.zh: 某星始見，某星已中，某星將入，或左或右，或遲或速，皆與天象吻合，無纖毫差。

translations.literal: When a certain star first appears, when a certain star has culminated, when a certain star is about to set — whether left or right, slow or swift — all match the heavenly image without the slightest discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: When a star first appears, when it culminates, when it is about to set — whether to left or right, slow or fast — everything matches the sky without the slightest error.

sentences.zh: 玉衡植於屏外，持扼樞鬥，注水激輪，其下為機輪四十有三，鉤鍵交錯相持，次第運轉，不假人力，多者日行二千九百二十八齒，少者五日行一齒，疾徐相遠如此，而同發於一機，其密殆與造物者侔焉。

translations.literal: The jade balance is planted outside the screen, holding the pivot's dipper; water is poured to drive the wheel; below are forty-three machine wheels; hooks and keys interlock in mutual hold; in sequence they turn without human force — the many run two thousand nine hundred twenty-eight teeth a day, the few one tooth in five days; fast and slow so far apart yet all issuing from one machine — the precision nearly equals the Maker's.
translations.idiomatic: The jade balance stands outside the screen, gripping the pivot's dipper; water is poured to drive the wheel beneath, where forty-three gear trains mesh by interlocking keys and turn in sequence without human hand — the fastest wheel runs two thousand nine hundred twenty-eight teeth a day, the slowest one tooth in five days; so wide the spread of speeds, yet all born of a single engine, its fineness nearly that of the Maker himself.

sentences.zh: 自余悉如唐一行之制。

translations.literal: The remainder all follows Tang Yixing's system.
translations.idiomatic: Everything else follows the system of Tang Yixing.

sentences.zh: 然一行舊制機關，皆用銅鐵為之，澀即不能自運，今制改以堅木若美玉之類。

translations.literal: Yet Yixing's old mechanism used copper and iron throughout; when sluggish it could not turn of itself; the present design changes to hard wood or fine jade and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yixing's old mechanism relied entirely on copper and iron, which when stiff would not turn of themselves; the present design substitutes hard wood or fine jade and the like.

sentences.zh: 舊制外絡二輪，以綴日月，而二輪蔽虧星度，仰視躔次不審，今制日月皆附黃道，如蟻行磑上。

translations.literal: The old design had two outer wheels to link sun and moon, and the two wheels obscured and eclipsed star degrees so that looking up at the lodges' sequence was unclear; the present design sets sun and moon both attached to the ecliptic, like ants walking on a millstone.
translations.idiomatic: The old design bound two outer wheels to carry sun and moon, and those wheels blocked and eclipsed star degrees so that looking up at the lodges' sequence was unclear; the new design fixes both sun and moon to the ecliptic, like ants crawling on a millstone rim.

sentences.zh: 舊制雖有合望，而月體常圓，上下弦無辨，今以機轉之，使圓缺隱見悉合天象。

translations.literal: The old design, though it had conjunction and full moon, kept the moon's body always round and could not distinguish the upper and lower quarters; now it is turned by mechanism so that waxing, waning, concealment, and appearance all match the heavenly phenomena.
translations.idiomatic: The old mechanism could mark conjunction and full moon, but the moon always appeared round and could not show the first and third quarters; the new design turns it by gears so that every phase of waxing, waning, and visibility matches the sky.

sentences.zh: 舊制止有候刻辰鐘鼓，晝夜短長與日出入更籌之度，皆不能辨，今制為司辰壽星，運十二時輪，所至時刻，以手指之，又為燭龍，承以銅荷，時正吐珠振荷，迴圈自運。

translations.literal: The old design had only clepsydra ke, double-hour bells and drums; the shortening and lengthening of day and night and the degrees of sunrise, sunset, watches, and tally-sticks could not be distinguished. The new design makes a Time-Keeper Longevity Star that drives a twelve-double-hour wheel; at each moment reached, a finger points to it. There is also a Candle Dragon bearing a bronze lotus; at the correct hour it spits a pearl and shakes the lotus, and the ring turns of itself.
translations.idiomatic: The old device only struck bells and drums for clepsydra marks and double-hours; it could not show how day and night lengthen and shorten or how sunrise, sunset, watches, and night watches shift. The new design adds a Time-Keeper figure that drives a twelve-hour wheel and points to each moment, and a Candle Dragon on a bronze lotus that, at the proper hour, releases a pearl, shakes the lotus, and sets the ring turning on its own.

sentences.zh: 其制皆出一行之外。

translations.literal: Its design all goes beyond what Yi Xing achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Every feature of the design goes beyond what Yi Xing had accomplished.

sentences.zh: 即其器觀之，全象天體者，璿璣也；

translations.literal: Viewed as an instrument, what fully images the heavenly body is the Xuanji;
translations.idiomatic: Among its parts, the component that fully represents the celestial sphere is the armillary sphere itself, the Xuanji;

sentences.zh: 運用水鬥者，玉衡也。

translations.literal: what drives the water scoop is the Yuheng.
translations.idiomatic: and the part that drives the water scoop is the Yuheng.

sentences.zh: 昔人或謂璣衡為渾天儀，或謂有璣而無衡者為渾天象，或謂渾儀望筒為衡：皆非也。

translations.literal: People of old sometimes called the Jiji and Yuheng the armillary sphere, or called a device with Ji but no Heng the celestial globe, or called the armillary sighting tube the Heng — all are wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier scholars sometimes identified the entire Jiji-Yuheng with the armillary sphere, or called a globe with Ji but no Heng a celestial model, or took the sighting tube of the armillary instrument for the Heng — all of which is mistaken.

sentences.zh: 甚者莫知璣衡為何器。

translations.literal: In the extreme case they did not even know what instrument the Jiji and Yuheng were.
translations.idiomatic: Some did not even know what sort of instrument the Jiji and Yuheng were meant to be.

sentences.zh: 唯鄭康成以運轉者為璣，持正者為衡，以今制考之，其說最近。

translations.literal: Only Zheng Xuan took the rotating part as Ji and the part that holds alignment as Heng; tested against the present design, his explanation comes closest.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zheng Xuan identified the rotating component as Ji and the stabilizing component as Heng; compared with the present mechanism, his account comes nearest the truth.

sentences.zh: 又月之晦明，自昔弗燭厥理，獨揚雄云：「月未望則載魄於西，既望則終魄於東，其溯於日乎？」

translations.literal: Again, the moon's waxing and waning — since antiquity its principle has not been illuminated; only Yang Xiong said: "Before full moon the moon's spirit is carried in the west; after full moon its spirit ends in the east — does it follow the sun?"
translations.idiomatic: As for the moon's phases, antiquity never fully explained them. Yang Xiong alone wrote, "Before the full moon its spirit is borne in the west; after the full moon its spirit ends in the east — does it follow the sun?"

sentences.zh: 京房云：「月有形無光，日照之乃光。」

translations.literal: Jing Fang said: "The moon has form but no light; only when the sun shines on it does it shine."
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang said, "The moon has form but no light of its own; only sunlight makes it bright."

sentences.zh: 始知月本無光，溯日以為光。

translations.literal: Only then was it known that the moon originally has no light and borrows light by following the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Thus it was understood that the moon has no inherent light and shines only by facing the sun.

sentences.zh: 本朝沈括用彈況月，粉塗其半，以象對日之光，正側視之，始盡圓缺之形。

translations.literal: In our dynasty Shen Kuo used a ball of clay for the moon, powdered half of it, to represent light facing the sun; viewed straight on and from the side, one first sees the full shape of roundness and crescent.
translations.idiomatic: In our own dynasty Shen Kuo modeled the moon with a clay ball, whitened half its surface to represent sunlight, and viewed it head-on and from the side, thereby showing every shape from full disk to crescent.

sentences.zh: 今制與三者之說若合符節。

translations.literal: The present design tallies with the statements of these three as if matching tallies and joints.
translations.idiomatic: The present mechanism agrees with all three accounts as if their seals matched exactly.

sentences.zh: 宜命有司置局如樣制，相址於明堂或合台之內，築台陳之，以測上象。

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the responsible offices to set up a bureau according to the model, choose a site within the Bright Hall or the Joint Terrace, build a platform and display it, to observe the phenomena above.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices should be ordered to establish a workshop from the model, choose a site within the Bright Hall or Joint Terrace, erect a platform, and install the instrument there to observe the heavens.

sentences.zh: 又別制三器，一納禦府，一置鐘鼓院，一備車駕行幸所用。

translations.literal: Also make three separate instruments separately: one for the Imperial Storehouse, one for the Bell and Drum Court, one kept ready for use when the imperial carriage travels on tour.
translations.idiomatic: Three additional instruments should be built: one for the Imperial Storehouse, one for the Bell and Drum Court, and one kept ready for the emperor's travels.

sentences.zh: 仍著為成書，以詔萬世。

translations.literal: Still compile it into a finished book to instruct ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: A full book should also be compiled so that the design may instruct generations to come.

sentences.zh: 詔以討論製造璣衡所為名，命黼總領，內侍梁師成副之。

translations.literal: An edict named the office the Bureau for Discussing and Manufacturing the Jiji and Yuheng, appointed Fu to direct it overall, and the inner attendant Liang Shicheng as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established the Bureau for Discussing and Manufacturing the Jiji and Yuheng, placed Fu in overall charge, and made the inner attendant Liang Shicheng his deputy.
